posts.tagline: Turn any portrait into a cinematic character card
posts.description: TitleHero is a native iPhone and iPad app that turns a photo into a bold, shareable character card. Pick a photo, compare 25 original looks, edit the title, then export a PNG in the format you need. The first three looks are fully editable and export cleanly. Everything is processed on-device, with no account, backend, or photo upload required.

posts.name: Capio
posts.tagline: From First Click To First Day On Campus
posts.description: Capio is an AI-powered international student recruitent and enrolment platform for higher education insttutions. Its product suite covers the full enrolmentlifecycle: Capio Engage (conversational AI in 95+ laguages), Capio Admit (AI-powered application processng), Capio Train (agent training and compliance), an Capio Plan (enrolment market intelligence). 30+ insitutions across Canada, the US, the UK, and Europe ue Capio to capture high-intent students and enrol thm faster.

posts.name: Get Post AI
posts.tagline: Turn a rough idea into a post people actually read
posts.description: Most AI writers hand you a wall of text you still have to fix. Get Post AI does one job: you type the idea messy, in any language, and get a post that's ready to publish. Then you shape it in one tap — tone, length, more or fewer emojis — translate it into 44 languages, and share it anywhere. Every post is saved on your device. Rebuilt from scratch: new design, post history, and refine controls.

posts.name: Tideline
posts.tagline: A tidy Downloads folder, every morning
posts.description: A macOS app that files older downloads into folders named for the day they arrived. Today's files stay loose in the root, under their real names, where you expect them. Write your own rules, or file by type for more structure. Find duplicates and forgotten folders, and take the space back. Nothing is ever deleted, nothing is ever overwritten. Set it up in the window, close it, and it keeps filing from the menu bar. Free, open source, no account, no telemetry.

posts.name: Binee
posts.tagline: Proactive AI operations brain for growing teams
posts.description: Binee is a proactive AI business brain that plugs on top of all your tools. Built from 20.000 hours of real operations expertise. Could you build this yourself in ChatGPT or Claude? Yes. We have, many times for clients. Prompts, skills, wiring, and babysitting all of it when something breaks, for every person on the team. Binee is that setup, finished and done correctly. One workspace for whole team with unlimited seats.

posts.name: Pomomap
posts.tagline: Put your productivity on the map
posts.description: A 25-minute Pomodoro timer with a world map for a scoreboard. Finish a block and your country gets brighter. Do it enough and you're the top contributor holding it - until someone out-focuses you. No signup to start, no pause, no ads, no notifications.

posts.name: Global Weather Pro
posts.tagline: Bring live, animated weather to your WordPress site
posts.description: Weather doesn't have to be static. Global Weather Pro brings your WordPress site to life with AI-generated animations for 60+ weather conditions Go beyond the temperature with current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecasts, air quality information, and weather alerts, all without requiring you to manage an API key Built for modern WordPress, add Global Weather Pro using a native Gutenberg block, classic widgets, or shortcodes, then make it your own with themes, layouts, and 18 professional fonts

posts.name: Nimbalyst Teams
posts.tagline: Multiplayer for Claude Code and Codex
posts.description: Nimbalyst Teams is the multiplayer visual workspace for teams building with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more. People and their local agents edit shared docs, mockups, diagrams, and trackers in real time collaboratively, with team chat built in. Ask your team for feedback

posts.name: Junior 3.0!
posts.tagline: Comment on LinkedIn as your company page
posts.description: Turn LinkedIn conversations into opportunities. Junior helps job seekers, founders, consultants, and sales teams engage in the right conversations with natural comments. Junior finds relevant LinkedIn posts and writes comments in your voice, running on your own machine and browser. 3.0 adds an Operator Console, an Activity log with skip reasons, Run Insights, and commenting as your LinkedIn company page.

posts.name: Blinky
posts.tagline: Stories that glow at bedtime and buzz with wonder
posts.description: A new podcast platform for families built on the belief that the best adventures happen with eyes closed and imagination wide open. Blinky offers a hand-picked world of audio and video podcasts that are safe for young listeners and loved by grown-ups too. Unlike general-purpose podcast platforms, Blinky makes sound the star - giving children a way to explore stories, wonder, and learning without a bright screen pulling them back in.

posts.name: IPLookup.tech
posts.tagline: Free IP intelligence: lookup, leak tests & risk scoring
posts.description: IPLookup.tech is a free IP intelligence toolkit. Look up any IPv4/IPv6 for geolocation, ASN, ISP and a fully transparent risk score that cross-checks Spamhaus, IPsum and X4BNet blacklists — we show exactly which list flagged an IP and when. Beyond lookup: DNS & WebRTC leak tests, browser fingerprinting checks, DNS propagation across 20+ global resolvers, TCP port checker, email header analyzer (trace origin + SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and a free JSON API without keys. Available in 10 languages.

posts.name: Kloot
posts.tagline: Turn your phone into a live control deck for your stream
posts.description: Kloot is a live control deck for streamers: one browser source in OBS adds giveaways, polls, lower thirds, alerts, counters and hype effects — everything fired by hand from a deck in your browser or your phone. Viewers join giveaways and vote in polls by scanning a QR code or typing a short join code — no chat bot, no account needed. Works on Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok. Free tier is real; Creator's $15/mo, Pro's $25/mo, and a 7-day Pro trial's included.

posts.name: Pomeroy
posts.tagline: Pomeroy connects Claude to eight native Apple MacOS apps
posts.description: Pomeroy connects Claude Desktop to 8 Mac apps: Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Notes, Contacts, Messages, Maps and Shortcuts. Each app starts switched off. Free for 50 actions a week; $19 once to remove the weekly limit.

posts.name: EMMA
posts.tagline: A local AI that remembers you for life and never phones home
posts.description: Pull your ethernet cable out and she keeps talking. EMMA runs on your own hardware — no account, no cloud, nowhere for your words to go. She remembers you across years and model swaps, acts on your files with undo and an audit log, and thinks while you sleep. Free for 60 days, Windows / macOS / Linux — no card, nothing to sign up for.

posts.name: FameScale
posts.tagline: Post across every page your brand runs, in one click.
posts.description: FameScale helps teams schedule and rotate short-form videos across multiple social accounts, avoid duplicate blasting, and track every video/account posting state.

posts.name: RevaultAI
posts.tagline: The AI-Native Creative Vault for Independent Filmmakers
posts.description: Filmmakers lose thousands juggling disconnected tool subscriptions, losing track of raw asset seeds, and struggling to monetize their work. We built Revault AI as a unified infrastructure layer for generative cinema.Our studio-grade workspace brings native video generation (Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0), advanced post-editing, and marketplace distribution into one secure dashboard. Includes a 100% free, no-login cinematic prompt optimizer.

posts.name: Kape
posts.tagline: Screen recordings worth posting. Free, in your browser.
posts.description: A screen recording of your site looks flat on a feed. Kape gives it a background, rounded corners and a shadow — then does the parts other browser tools skip. A real timeline: cut the fumbled click out of the middle, not just off the ends. Filmstrip, waveform, frame-level zoom. Real encoding: every frame decoded from the source, never filmed off playback, so nothing drops. Audio stays in sync across cuts. Any shape: 16:9 in, 9:16 or 1:1 out. Free. No account. Nothing uploaded.

posts.name: Phanes
posts.tagline: The Economic Operating System for AI Agents
posts.description: Identity. Contracts. Risk. Settlement. Consensus. Everything an autonomous AI agent needs to exist as an economic entity. 19 protocol modules. Formal verification. Zero-knowledge proofs.

posts.name: Petoi Quaddle:A Do-It-All Mini Robot Dog
posts.tagline: Your ticket to an open-source playground of robotics and AI
posts.description: Quaddle is an open-source desktop robot pet with surprisingly dynamic movement and expressive behavior. Powered by just 4 servos, it can walk, run, jump, interact with its surroundings, and even be controlled by your body. Built for makers, developers, and curious minds, Quaddle makes physical AI and robotics more accessible, hackable, and fun. You can play with its browser-based simulator (You can even run it on your phone): https://www.petoi.com/pages/quaddle-robot-simulator

posts.name: Even Ground
posts.tagline: One pass. 21 days. A product, figured out.
posts.description: EvenGround's Product Pass is a one-time ticket: in 21 days you get the PRD, architecture, timeline, and a real Next.js prototype. Fixed $3,500. One maker. No retainers. No fog.
